findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment:
The following canned foods on the shelves were observed to have dents:
1. Clover valley tomato sauce has significant dent on the body.
2. Red Gold tomato sauce has significant dent on the body.
3. Boyardee spaghetti and meat balls has significant dent at the bottom. 
4. Sweetened condensed milk has significant dent around the seam and body.

CORRECTED - The inspector informed the operator and the dented cans were removed from the shelves. Dented cans can have entry and harborage of botulism, ensure canned foods with dents are removed from the shelves when observed and not sold to customers.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [PF]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Light was observed to be passing beneath the exit door at the back storage. The inspector advised the operator to use weather strippings to seal the gap so as to prevent potential entry of pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: An opening was observed between the wall and handwashing sink in the male restroom. The operator was instructed to have the opening caulked for smooth and easy cleaning and to prevent water from entering the opening.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted. [C]

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

Observed the sink in the women's bathroom to be unable to turn off completely. Discussed with the person in charge and they stated that a ticket has been sent requesting maintenance of the fixture.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: 750-160 Observed chemicals being stored over single-service plates in the $1 aisles. Watch that single-service plates, cups etc items are stored over chemicals.  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Some of the shelves holding gallons of milk are observed thickly coated with spilled product/bottom of container remnants. These shelves should be taken outside and scrubbed clean.  Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text: 750.1110 (REPEAT) Observed no covered waste cans in both men and women's restrooms.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750.1210a (REPEAT) Caulk in the men's restroom at the handsink is coming apart from the wall. Recaulk the wall.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: 750.1050a Observed waste water not dumped from the night before. Dump waste water immediately after use.
